_note: Written from the dial table alone (dial_table.csv), before running exp_dials.py. Each entry: predicted change at year 150 (mean of years 145-155) for a +20% change in the dial (child_mort: -20%), as a relative change in percent, except hungry and gini in absolute points (x100). 0 means 'no effect expected (within +-2)'.

means._why: B1 setpoint: the late food ratio follows means; fewer heirs marry; the waiting go to town

tithe._why: office road: elite households = tithe / elite standard, a ratio; part of the extra income is spent in town

Wd1._why: R2: town food is set by goods demand; more wants, more food sold to town; pull raises clearing a little

town_d._why: B4: town settles near M/(d-b); d-b rises by more than 20%

child_mort._why: growth ceiling up ~0.3 points: about 8 years sooner to each size; more waiting adults; output follows farm population
